methodology: Loads release the target number of routable gateway trips at t = 0 on the compiled network, walk warmup_s of simulation time so the first links can discharge, then time measure_ticks calls of step(1.0). Stage times come from the stepper's own timers over that window. Allocation counts are armed only around those steps. Each thread count is a fresh process whose Rayon pool is built at that width. The 24-hour run is the diurnal boundary instrument, the same loop the headless experiment uses.
